tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub thabs sa bskang nang bzhugs ltar ro// ༈ /de nas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri padma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ skyabs 'gro'i yul bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam la/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o//

zhes nyer gcig tsam/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi// dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul ba'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la// dgos pa gsum gyis lus 'bul lo// tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo// sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang gi snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dpal rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra āñdza li hūm̐/ badzra bandha badzra āñdza li dzaḥ yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol la/ phaṭaḥ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams// songs shig lha min lha yang rung*// nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos// oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bi ghanna bhandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dhā hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha ni la ḍāṇḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

oṃ badzra kro dha ya manta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la hūm̐ bandha bandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshindhā tshindha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐ bindha bindha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kro dha mahā bā la hūm̐ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sems kyis snying ga'i hūm̐ las rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rgya gram/ dbyug tho rnams spros nas 'og tu de dag gi sa gzhi/ logs su rwa ba/ steng du gur la sogs par gyur par bsam ste/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sbyar mthe'u chung sbrel/ mthe bos srin mdzub mnan/ gung mdzub gnyis gyen du bsgrengs pa'i phyag rgya g.yon du bskor zhing bgegs bsgrad/ g.yas su bskor ba rwa gur du gyur par bsam la/ hūm̐/ khro bo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byung*/ g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad de rwa bar gyur/ hūm̐/ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir// khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i// mtshon bya rnam pa sna tshogs kyis// dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srungs/ oṃ badzra a yu ta rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra a yu ta rakṣa hūm̐/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa rin po che'i rnam par byas pa dang*/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas// dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad kyi// log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// oṃ badzra te dzwa tiṣṭha tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra te dzwa tiṣṭha tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ḥ ces dang*/ rwa ba de rnams las 'phros pa'i mes bgegs thams cad bsregs par gyur

par bsam zhing*/ thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i sor mo gzhan bsnol mthe bong rtse sprad pa dang*/ phyi rol kun tu 'od 'phros pas// bdud dpung nges par sreg byed pa// sa dang mkha' kun khyab pa yi// 'bar ba me yi phung por gyur// oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bha ñdza ra ṇa hūm̐/ srung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na mo badzra kī li kī la ya maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra bhyaḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// zhes tshar gsum/ mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying khar thim/ yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin brlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ a la la hoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya staṃḥ zhes brjod/ de'i dus kyi dmigs pa ni snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas bla ma dang yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam pas mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs par sangs rgyas thams cad yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'brel ba'i 'od kyi rnam pa can sbyor mtshams nas byung rang gnas la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa le hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rang gi thugs kha nas raṃ dmar po spros pa'i mes bdud rtsi dang gtor ma'i snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/

yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ bhrūṃ spros pas bandha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ oṃ spros pas 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃḥ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa yangs par hūm̐ oṃ tram̐ hrīḥ.āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa/ hūm̐ oṃ swa āḥhāḥlas phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ hūm̐ badzra dhrika/ oṃ dzī na dzikaḥ swa ratna dhīkaḥ ā a ro lika hā pradzñā dhrikaḥ he ru ka yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sbyor ba'i mes 'od du zhu oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas bstim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'brel bas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī thaḥ lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te guhya sid dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī thaḥ lan gsum/ rakta'i snod āḥlas thod pa yangs par rāḥlas dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ ma surya maṇḍal spha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ hā ra ṇa hūm̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwo la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrī thaḥ lan gsum/ yang hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la yaḥ phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i lus la khro bo bcus brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dngos gzhi ni/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ stong pa nyid des 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing*/

de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ thabs shes rab gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur pa/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/ oṃ mahā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃḥ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃḥ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod// mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ba// nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar// srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang*// snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya// hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃḥspha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pa'i rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ waṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ kaṃ e spha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag 'phros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ eḥlas mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil// yaṃḥlas rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan// de steng waṃḥlas byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar// raṃḥlas me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed// laṃḥlas sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur// de'i steng rakta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /dbus su keṃ rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng*// gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras// dzaḥpāṃ padma maṇḍa laḥ mā sūrya maṇḍa laḥ ā tsaṇḍa maṇḍa laḥ ma hā de ba dzaḥ u ma de wi dzaḥ padma nyi ma zla ba/ dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rgyu yi ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de babs pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus te 'od du zhu nas rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhandha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ gdan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku// mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal// rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang*// me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams// g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams// mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags// mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar// ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes// glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol// stag gi pags pa'i 'og pags can// dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan// dbu rgyan se ral sked bcings dang*// phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas// rakta zhag dang thal chen gyi// thig le zo ris tshom bur bris// sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras// zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas// dbang phyug kha phub mgo bo dang*// u ma'i nu ma rab tu brdzis// ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs// rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched skra// nyi khri chig stong ba spu bye ba phrag

/phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang*// rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra bas go mtshams med par gtams par gyur/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// bsad cing mnan pa nyid min te// phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de// rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom// bhrum̐ bi ma na mahā sūr ya dzñā na sa twa kriṣṇa shu ka pañtsa badzra hūm̐ḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo// g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs// gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can// rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la brgyan// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas// sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// rakta zhag dang thal chen gyi// thig le zo ris tshom bur byas// zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyangs bskum gyis// yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud par bzhugs// rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams// 'khor ba rdo rje grub par mdzod// oṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ḥ 'khor ba rdo rje phur ba'i lha// ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod// oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra yakṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badzra bhāai ra be hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ bām̐/ oṃ badzra ma ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs su dpral ba mgrin pa snying khar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam nas de dag las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum du gyur par bsam la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa// sku yi gter du bdag bskyed cig

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung*// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa// gsung gi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wākka badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃḥ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs// rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las// chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi zad pa// thugs kyi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃḥ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros khro bo rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spyan drangs dbang bskur gsol ba gdab par bsam zhing*/ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod// dbang dang byin brlabs 'dir stsol cig /de nas ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor he ru ka yab yum gyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ḥ oṃ bud dha shrī he ru ka bud dha kro dhi shwa ri oṃḥ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhi shwa ri trāṃḥ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhi shwa ri hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri āḥ phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ e spha ra ṇa phaṭaḥ phur gdan āe las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar bar bskyed/ sarba shā truṃ bigha nan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod dus gru gsum gyi dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad bkug bar bsam/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshin dha tshin dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan rakṣaḥrakṣaḥ zhes brjod pa'i dus mdun gyi phur pa gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ yungs kar gyis brab rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ chad pas sras mchog zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhabs bzhi ba'i skur bsam/

skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las// skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus kun// sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/

/zhes pas chos sku las longs sku he ru kar bzhengs par bskul ba mkha' nang nas longs sku yab yum sprul par bsam ste/ phyag mtshan gtso bo dang 'dra'o// de nas longs sku las sprul sku sras mchog sprul bar gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir/ hūm̐/ dbus kyi mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas// rdo rje 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro rgyal dbyings nas bzhengs// srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir// mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs// badzra kī li kī la ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pas longs sku las sprul sku sras mchog stod khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ smad phur bu'i rnam pa can du bsam/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ sked par hrīḥ rtse mor phaṭaḥ ces pas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ badzra sa ma dzaḥ zhes pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa bstim/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ sogs nas gong bzhin dbang bskur/ mā surya maṇḍalaḥ ā tsaṇḍa maṇḍalaḥ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ swā āḥhāḥ saṃ maṃ laṃ paṃ taṃḥ sa ma ya st+waṃḥ badzra añdza li hūm̐ badzra bandha badzra añdza li dzaḥ ces dang phur pa chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas bzung nas/ dipta tsakra phur pa'i lha// mthing nag gcer bu ral ba can// sku stod khro bo chen po la// zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste// dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs// lte ba man chad sku yi cha// utpal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba// 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od// lcags kyi phur ba zur gsum pa// drag por gyur pa'i phur ba ste// btab na lha yang brlag 'gyur na// gnod byed bgegs la smros ci dgos// lte ba man chad sku yi cha sogs la phur bu bsgril nas/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

badzra a bhi ṣiñtsaḥ phur pa'i mgo bo spyi gtsug tu reg oṃ dipta tsakra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsaḥ dpral bar reg oṃ dipta ratna kī li kī la sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsaḥ rna ltag g.yas par/ oṃ dipta padma kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ padma a bhi ṣiñtsaḥ ltag par/ oṃ dipta karma kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ karma a bhi ṣiñtsaḥ rna ltag g.yon par/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃḥ dpral bar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wakka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ mgrin par/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ snying khar reg pas khro bo khro mo thams cad kyi phrin las bdag la 'dus bar bsam/ de nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor la dam can srung mas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam zhing badzra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang*// sprul pa yang sprul bka' stod srung ma'i tshogs// glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// sngags kyi sgang la rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu rgyun dkrol byed/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang dag don du dag mod kyang*// 'gro ba kun gyi don slad du// phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang*// rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// rdo rje g.yab cing dril bu dkrol/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ha sta tsa pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha badzra a sa na tiṣṭhantu/ zhes pas zhabs bsil gdan 'bul/ bde bar gshegs so khro rgyal gtso// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ye shes kyis// srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun// kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol//

dril bu rgyun dkrol/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hāḥ ces mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod/ sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma// mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bskang nas// bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la// rnam dag blo yi mos blos bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// badzra la sya hūm̐/ 'di nas shabda'i bar la ḍā ma ru rgyun dkrol dang dril bu gsum brdung byed/ badzra mā le traṃḥ badzra gīrti hrīḥ badzra nirti āḥ badzra dhu pe hūm̐ḥ badzra puṣpe trāṃḥ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ badzra gandhe āḥ oṃ badzra nai wi dyā āḥhūm̐ḥ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ḥ nang mchod nas bdud rtsi blang zhing gtor/ rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi// rtsa brgyud stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas// rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol phyir// dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po// thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i phyir// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la// sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du// bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la// 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la ban dha mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa ma lus dang*// dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ 'jigs byed chen po khro bcu yab yum dang*// sprul ba'i khra thabs yab yum nyi shu dang*// sgo ma bzhi dang sras mchog phur ba'i tshogs// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang*// ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum sde dang*// dpag bsam shing lha re ma ti rnams la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ shwa na mu kha bdag nyid chen mo dang*// bse yi lha mo phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor tshogs// dam srung mched lcam bstan ma bcu gnyis la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul// thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol// mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā hi/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du khā hi/ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i zhal du khā hi/ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal du khā hi/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas zhal du khā hi/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du khā hī/ khyad par chos skyong bsrung ma'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rang gi lce la nang mchod bzhag nas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// rigs 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas la// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ 'khril pa'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i// padmo la ni rdo rje bzhugs// bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par byos// sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ ra go a nu ra ga ya mi bodhi tsitta/ mnyam pa'i bsgrub rdzas chen po ste// bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni// dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor thim// a la la ste dkyil 'khor thim// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka mahā badzra ā be sha ya ā be sha ya/ pra be sha ya pra be sha ya/ mahā su kha pra tītstsha hoḥ pra ti gṛ ha na kha hi/

bsgral mchod ni/ rang gi thugs kha nas khro bo khro mo phra thabs sgo ma sras mchog dam can bcu gnyis kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad bsgral bar bsam zhing*/ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs// pho nya chen po'i dus la babs// bdag nyid chen po'i dus la babs// sa bdag chen mo'i dus la babs// khyi yi gdong can dus la babs// bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la babs// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bzhin du// rigs 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni// gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams// khro bo chen po'i byin brlabs kyis// yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la// mngon spyod tshul gyis bsgral ba dang*// lus ngag phye mar mdzad nas kyang*// sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod// oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ staṃ bha ni/ mo haṃ gha ta ya/ bha ga wān/ hrīḥṣṭiḥwi kri badzra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ badzra kī li kī la ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsarba bigha nan badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaḥ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭaḥ dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi mchod par bsam la/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang*/ 'di nas badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi bar du ḍā ma ru rgyun dkrol dang dril bu drag brdung byed/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te// dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru// zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas// dmar gyi arghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil// khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka mahā sa ma ya raktas mu dra kha kha khā hi khā hiḥhri da ya bi pa tha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

nga ni za byed chen po ste// khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang*// gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir// sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya// nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste// dmar gyi arghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil// 'khor ba'i drwa ba gcod pa'i phyir// 'khor gyi phra men tshogs rnams kyis// ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka mahā ru dhi ra khā hiḥ mahā maṃ sa khā hiḥ mahā ma ta ka khā hiḥ mahā asthi khā hiḥ de thams cad la gtor ma'i steng du rakta bsgrengs/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi ljags las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃḥ puṣpaṃḥ dhu paṃḥ dī paṃḥ ghandhaṃḥ ba liṃ ta pra ti'atstsha ham̐ḥ gṛhṇa khā hiḥ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ sgeg cing dpa' dang mi gdug tshul ston cing*/ */tshigs bcad re la rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu gsil/ rgod dang gshed dang 'jigs su rung ba dang*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa// gar dgu'i rol mdzad rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku// e ka dza ti gu hya gsang ba'i yum// hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang smig bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal sgeg mo stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems spyang khra'i mgo /'khyil ba sgra mdzad seṅge pha wang mgo /khams gsum gsod ma dred dang spre mong mgo /stobs chen rig byed dom dang byi la'i mgo /gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma// dngos grub mchog stsol ye shes chen po'i sku// dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' bsrung dam can tshogs// phrin las bzhi bsgrub dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// rigs lnga khro bcu sgo ma rnam pa bzhi// bgegs 'dul byang chub sems kyi dngos la bstod/

bzlas ba'i skabs su/ hūm̐ badzra dzñā na kī li kī la yaḥ zhes brjod dus rang gi snying kha'i ye shes sems dpa' las/ de dang 'dra ba yum med pa gcig mdun du phye nas rang la zhal phyogs par bzhugs/ dzñā na sa twa e tri ko nā bi ma nāḥpāṃ padma maṇḍa la/ mā surya maṇḍa laḥ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍa laḥ hūm̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bigha nan bhan dha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes brjod dus rang gi snying khar gru gsum mthing nag gi dbus su padma nyi zla'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra yum med pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje 'bras tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ sngon po yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar/ kī la ya'i sngags kha dog sngon po skra shad kyis bris pa lta bu g.yas bskor du bsam nas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// dbang phyug u ma bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas// bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni// sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med// 'khor gyi phra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs// yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i lha// drag po rang byung dbang dang dngos grub stsol// rang gi snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las sngags 'phreng kha dog sngon po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba lcags sgrog sbrel ba lta bu rdo rje'i dbus rwa nas byung*/ ye shes sems dpa' dang rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'thon/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ de'i thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang de las sngags phreng byung*/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas nas 'thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon dang ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i dbus rwa nas song*/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing*/ sngags phreng phyir 'gro ba'i dus de las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dpag tu med pa spros/

sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bgegs dang bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gyur/ sngags phreng nang du 'ong dus sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs rang gi kī li ya brjod pa'i tshe mdun gyi bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor/ bla ma yi dam nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ sems can yi dam gyi lhar gyur pa thams cad kyis rang gi sngags bzlas grogs byed par bsam zhing*/ sngags phreng rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba la sems gtad pa ni man ngag dam pa yin no// bzlas 'phro 'jog pa na yum gyi sngags/

oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes ci rigs dang*/ mahā rakmoḥ yakmoḥ kā la ru paḥ snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃḥ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃḥ snying la khril khrilaḥ srog la chum chumaḥ tsitta srog la tuṃ tuṃḥ thuṃ ril rilaḥ snying khrag srog la shan shanaḥ snying tsheg tshegaḥ 'ur 'uraḥ shig shigaḥ gul gulaḥ nyag nyagaḥ gsod gsodaḥ dha ti ma ma shrī ghraṃ karma ka ra ma ra se na pra mar dha ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sogs bzhi snying cig tu dril ba cung zad bzlas la/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bcug nas kha rlangs phog par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun// sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la// gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*// kī la ya ye dngos grub stsol// oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa/ tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhimme pra ya tstshaḥ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan badzra he ru ka /mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gsum/ oṃ shrī badzra ku ma ra kro dha rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

oṃ badzra ka wa tse hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces pas lus bsrung zhing go cha bgo dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun// bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas// rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi// 'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i// lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs// myur du bsgrubs nas tshe 'di kho na la// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa// nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams// bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas// kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar// skye dang skye bar gnas bzang po// rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang*// grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrin// rnam par dag cing rgyud cig la// skal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te// thos nas legs bshad ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan bcing*// lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin// ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla// yid kyis zung 'jug bsgom par shog /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar// bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing*// sgrub la bar chad med pa dang*// bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang*// dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces brjod pas dge ba bsngo/ de nas bkra shis ni/ mtshungs med bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mthu stobs dbang phyug bla ma brgyud par bcas// mtshan nas brjod dam cung zad dran yang rung*// bkra shis des kyang skye dgu bde legs shog /padma'i lte bar bdud bzhi'i steng na brjid// yon tan mtha' yas ye shes lnga yi dngos// he ru ka dpal bdag med rnal 'byor ma// bkra shis des kyang skye dgu bde legs shog

/bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i padmar rdo rjes rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las// thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa// bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi// skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog /hūm̐ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa'i sku// hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i gsung*// spros pa nyer zhi mkha' dbyings chen po'i thugs// dpal 'bar mahā kā la'i bkra shis shog /sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la// bar chad srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang dbang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzambha lha// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad kyi bkra shis shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang*// 'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs pa yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i// dkon mchog gsum gyi deng 'dir bde legs stsol// 'dir bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad nyi ma dang zla ba gza' sgra gcan gyi kha nas thar ba ltar spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas bkra shis dang dge legs kyi 'byor pa'i dpal dam pa thob par gyur cig /ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ta/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇaḥ ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/
slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
